output.summary: Zero deviations followed the Feb 2026 supervisor bonus penalty per deviation report, while independent QC rejections (0.8% to 1.3%) and complaints (11 to 31 ppm) rose and psychological safety fell. This indicates suppressed reporting, not quality gains. Line 3's output edge vanishes once badge-recorded borrowed technicians are counted, so it is not a transferable model. Line 3 accounts for 71% of traceable luer-leak complaints, consistent with hidden rework, and the supplier switch does not explain this. Training timing does not fit. Whether the Plant Manager directed the lending is unestablished. Best actions: suspend the penalty with amnesty, and run an independent investigation. Do not adopt Line 3 as a model, discipline now, or unmask the reporter.
